pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty ALERT -> INC-2026-457 fired for service= inference-api-eu. symptom=rolling 5m 5xx spike (~18%). Link: https://pagerduty.example/INC-2026-457 
incident-bot: Created incident INC-2026-457 · severity=P1 · runbook: https://confluence.redwood/runbooks/inference-prod · suggested responders: @Maya Chen, @Jordi Patel
Maya Chen: ACK. I'm the current eu-oncall, grabbing this now. :wave:
Jordi Patel: joining. oncall handover incoming? i'll stand by to validate mitigation.
Samir Gupta: seeing flood of 504s in nginx logs, plus a handful of `kv cache miss -> fallback` traces. sample: `2026-03-15T07:21:12Z inference-proxy 504 GET /v1/generate  rt=234ms`
Priya Rao: linking support queue — multiple tickets flagged from EU customers. estimated customer-impact ~12-15 orgs. putting them in the incident doc.
Maya Chen: quick checklist from runbook: 1) confirm traffic location 2) toggle to warm pool 3) scale inference-proxy 4) watch error rate. will attempt traffic toggle first.
Jordi Patel: If toggle fails, we have plan B to reduce concurrency per worker and enable short-circuit cache.
Maya Chen: running toggle: `./tools/traffic-toggle --service inference-api --from eu --to us-west --dry-run=false`
incident-bot: automated remediation: traffic-toggle STARTED by Maya Chen at 3390011240
Maya Chen: traffic-toggle completed. verifying. :eyes:
Samir Gupta: quick metric ping: grafana -> https://grafana.redwood/d/inf-prod/errors?orgId=1 now shows 5xx down from 18% -> ~7% (rolling 5m). still some tail.
Priya Rao: updating support: "We've routed traffic away from EU pool; mitigation in progress. We'll follow up with ETA for full recovery." (sent) :email:
Jordi Patel: checking cache nodes health: `curl -s http://cache-eu.svc/health | jq .` returns 200 but latency spiking. might be load-related.
Maya Chen: also scaled inference-proxy: `kubectl -n prod scale deploy inference-proxy --replicas=12` — pods coming up.
Samir Gupta: request logs show reduced 504s after scale + toggle. error rate trending to 3.8% now.
incident-bot: Bridge created: https://meet.redwood/bridge/INC-2026-457 · bridge-host=Maya Chen
Maya Chen: opening short handoff — I'm going to monitor for 20m. if stable we'll start handoff to followup owner for postmortem and customer comms.
Priya Rao: i'll take postmortem and customer follow-ups. noted items to collect: support ticket ids [#4871, #4874, #4879], request-id samples, grafana panels, and toggle timeline.
Jordi Patel: quick note — root cause hypothesis: surge of long-running embeddings requests from partner X causing proxy queue saturation + KV-cache pressure. collecting traces.
Samir Gupta: i've pulled trace sample ids: `trace-9a1b2`, `trace-9a1b3` and saved to incident doc.
Maya Chen: 10m status: error rate steady ~3.2%, 99th latency returning to baseline. continuing to monitor.
Priya Rao: contacting account lead for the affected customers; drafting customer note with timeline and mitigation steps.
Maya Chen: 20m status: stable for 15m after toggle/scale. i'm handing to Priya for follow-up. Priya, you good taking ownership for next steps? :thumbsup:
Priya Rao: taking ownership for follow-up and postmortem. will keep incident open in doc and close after customer comms + notes. ETA for postmortem draft ~3 hours.
incident-bot: Automated update: mitigation succeeded. marking incident as Acknowledged -> Mitigated at 3390011360
Maya Chen: closing live paging. leaving bridge. thanks all. :heart:
Priya Rao: adding handoff notes to incident doc and will file postmortem. leaving a summary in #postmortems when ready.
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-457 RESOLVED (status changed by Priya Rao) at 3390011380.
